prompt: Compose a message to a colleague acknowledging that their idea was not credited in a meeting and explaining how you will correct the omission. Use approximately 80 words for the response.
text: Hi Alex, I realized I discussed your idea in today’s meeting without acknowledging that it came from you. I’m sorry—you deserved clear credit, and I should have made that explicit. I’ll send a follow-up to everyone who attended, name you as the originator, and update the meeting notes to reflect your contribution. I’ll also acknowledge it at our next meeting so the correction is clear. Going forward, I’ll be more careful to credit your ideas when sharing them.
